# `armada project`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armada.md)

Projects hold apps, jobs, secrets, domains, and volumes (ADR 0026). Names only
need to be unique within a project. Every cluster has the project default,
which holds everything deployed without --project.

Commands work in the project `armada project use` saved, or the one --project
(or ARMADA_PROJECT) names, else default. An app of another project can also
be named NAME.PROJECT, which is how events and the internal host name
(NAME.PROJECT.internal) show it. Lists take -A for every project.

On a cluster with a cluster network, containers reach other apps only
through their internal names, resolve only their own project's names, and
the containers of every project but default are kept away from the nodes,
the private network, and the cloud's metadata service (network isolation;
for default, turn it on with `armada project set default --network-isolation`).

Also: `projects`.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armada project create`](#armada-project-create) | Create a project |
| [`armada project delete`](#armada-project-delete) | Delete an empty project |
| [`armada project list`](#armada-project-list) | List projects |
| [`armada project set`](#armada-project-set) | Change a project's settings |
| [`armada project show`](#armada-project-show) | Show a project's settings |
| [`armada project use`](#armada-project-use) | Work in a project: commands without --project use it |

## `armada project create`

Create a project.

```
armada project create NAME
```

## `armada project delete`

Delete a project. It must be empty: delete its apps, jobs, secrets, and
volumes first. The default project cannot be deleted.

```
armada project delete NAME
```

Also: `rm`.

## `armada project list`

List projects.

```
armada project list [flags]
```

Also: `ls`.

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |

## `armada project set`

Change a project's settings (cluster-admin only).

--network-isolation keeps the project's containers away from the nodes, the
control plane, the private network, and the cloud's metadata service: they
reach the internet, their node's DNS server, and internal and public
ingress (ADR 0026). Every project but default always has it; turn it on for
default once its apps no longer need the private network. It needs the
cluster network.

```
armada project set NAME --network-isolation[=false] [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--network-isolation` | keep the project's containers away from the platform and the private network |

## `armada project show`

Show a project's settings.

```
armada project show NAME [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |

## `armada project use`

Save NAME in the client config (--config) as the project commands work in when
neither --project nor ARMADA_PROJECT names one. `armada project use default`
goes back to the default project.

```
armada project use NAME
```
